llm_response.reason: The site claims to be a Caterpillar Italy outlet but has a very recently registered domain (July 2025) that does not belong to Caterpillar Inc. All organization contact details are hidden, and there is no legitimate business credential or official communication channel present. The website relies heavily on brand spoofing (Caterpillar), promises considerable discounts and free shipping—common psychological hooks in scams—and mimics the structure of legitimate outlets without any visible legitimate affiliation, thus fulfilling several scam characteristics, including #1, #4, #16.
